Stage 2: high-pass filter all QC-passed recordings

Source: R/02_filter_audio.R
pam_filter_audio.Rd

Applies a Butterworth high-pass (default 250 Hz, 48 dB/octave) with FFmpeg and writes filtered copies to paths$filtered, mirroring the folder structure and file names of paths$audio_standardized. Originals are never modified.

Usage

pam_filter_audio(cfg, master = NULL, force = FALSE)

Arguments

cfg

A pam_config object. Uses the filter section and paths.

master

Optional master table from pam_scan_audio()$master; if NULL it is read from metadata/audio_master.csv.

force

If TRUE, ignore the checkpoint and re-filter everything.

Value

Invisibly, a list: n_pending, n_ok, n_failed, results_file.

Details

Resumable: completed files are recorded in metadata/02_filter.done only after the output has been written and verified (readable, same duration, sample rate and channels). Per-file outcomes, including FFmpeg error text, are appended to metadata/02_filter_results.csv. Only files with qc_pass == TRUE are filtered. Run with pam_run_stage("02_filter", pam_filter_audio, cfg).
